name: Micro-Ad Engagement Funnel Siphon
phase: Low-Fidelity Prototyping and Smoke Testing Tactics
hypothesis: We believe that [Value Proposition Messaging A] resonates more strongly with consumers than [Messaging B]. We will verify this by running split ad campaigns with equal budget allocations across both messages, and consider it validated if Variant A yields a ≥ 40% higher Click-Through Rate (CTR) and ≥ 25% lower Cost Per Click (CPC) at statistical significance (p < 0.05).
schematic: Read at stage 3 of the 3-stage funnel

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Make identical assets that differ only in the headline: cost savings against time savings.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Run both ad sets at once on one platform, to one audience, with daily caps to avoid skew.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Track impressions, clicks, click-through and downstream page engagement per variant.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Create identical graphic assets that differ only in their core headline and copy hooks (e.g., Cost Savings vs. Time Savings).

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Launch simultaneous ad sets on a single acquisition platform targeting an identical audience segment. Set daily spending caps to avoid skewing data.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Track impressions, clicks, CTR, and downstream page engagement metrics across each creative variant.

warning.label: Clickbait Disconnection
warning.text: Curiosity copy wins clicks and cheap traffic that bounces on the real product page.

warningFull: Sensationalist or curiosity-driven ad copy can achieve high click-through rates and low acquisition costs while attracting visitors who bounce immediately once they land on the actual product page.
